name: chung-research-group-website
description: Validated static build and publication automation for the Chung Research Group GitHub Pages site.

scripts.check: node scripts/validate-site.mjs --root . && node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/validate-site.mjs --root dist --compare-source .
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:automation && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:automation: node --test tests/publication-bot.test.mjs tests/publication-citations.test.mjs tests/publication-metadata.test.mjs tests/lab-statistics.test.mjs tests/force-layout.test.mjs
